tasks.title: API updates last and stores padded addresses unchanged while rejecting invalid notify channels and reports
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, R7, all preconditions, Tests and Completion evidence; Rollout step 3, M1/M4 and Releases/deploy/rollback; Security impact; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 5-8. Writer runs last: targets.json depends on contract, console and notify; before ANY edit independently verify console main and notify main pins each contain the merged contract patch, otherwise needs-input hold naming the reader; api main must not already contain patch (hold if already present). Add three defect reject regressions, M4 padded-address round trip and unchanged 100-emoji accept control first in the real port-0 server suite; record old-pin assertion failures and controls passing. Old M4 actual 422 is mixed check M1, recorded as baseline. Then pin package.json and bun.lock to the full main patch merge SHA (2.5.1 or next free patch). No production-source change. Rejected clientName preserves storage, revision and audit. M4 creates with 201 and both admin/service GET routes return exact original padded spelling. Include full checks, reader-pin evidence, manual HTTP check, test CPU/startup CPU-RSS/full Docker A/B or nightly fallback, and readers-first activation/release/rollback rules.

acceptance.command: for reader in console notify; do gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-$reader/contents/package.json?ref=main" --jq .content | base64 -d | rg pulse-contract; done
acceptance.expected: Before any edit, independently read and record current console main's pin as CONSOLE_CONTRACT_PIN and notify main's pin as NOTIFY_CONTRACT_PIN; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA comes from merged contract child PR. Both reader PRs are already merged per targets.json.
Before any edit, identical or ahead: console main contains the patch. Otherwise needs-input hold naming console; api must not store padded addresses while its reader rejects the list.

Before any edit, identical or ahead: notify main contains the patch. Otherwise needs-input hold naming notify; api must not store padded addresses while notify rejects the channel or its ledger at open.
Before any edit, record api main's full contract pin as CONTRACT_BASELINE_PIN.

Before any edit, api main does not contain the patch: identical or ahead requires a hold because the behavior is already present; behind establishes today's old-pin precondition. Resolve any unestablished/diverged ancestry before editing.

On patch, 0 fail. POST /admin/notify/channels with pulse_console gives 422 and channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name, with storage/revision/audit unchanged; trailing-text from gives 422. PUT /service/notify/report with fileChannels[0].refs[0] of 101 emoji (202 units) gives 422, and 100 emoji (200 units) gives 204. M4: POST literal E("Ops < ops@example.test >") gives 201; GET /admin/notify/channels and GET /service/notify/channels return from === "Ops < ops@example.test >" unchanged. On old 2.4.0 pin the three reject cases and M4 fail by assertion (actual 201,201,204,422), the 100-emoji 204 control passes on both. The old padded-address 422 is M1; record error channel.from: must hold an email address and nothing stored. Full new-pin pass; focused global coverage status is not the test result.
exit 0; package.json and committed bun.lock agree.
exit 0; the repository's lint, typecheck and full test suite pass with the existing 80% line coverage gate; never weaken shared configuration.

Both files pin the same full patch merge SHA; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR); the lockfile resolution matches that commit.

ahead or identical; CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA is the full 40-character merge SHA independently obtained from the merged contract child PR implementing R1-R6 on main (2.5.1 on today's main, or the next free patch literal named in that PR), so the consumer pins a commit on contract main.
exit 0; API production source is unchanged.
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock and src/server.notify-channels.test.ts are changed or untracked.

Performance impact: run five samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch with the matching dependencies installed; all full test runs pass. Report median user + system seconds per side and their delta in the PR, never substitute wall time. Expected test CPU increase about 0.1-0.3 s. A test CPU increase above 0.5 s is reported as a finding (Acceptance evidence 8).

acceptance.command: bun -e 'const t=process.cpuUsage(); await import("@lorenzh/pulse-contract"); const c=process.cpuUsage(t); Bun.gc(true); console.log((c.user+c.system)/1000, process.memoryUsage().rss/1048576)'
acceptance.expected: Performance impact: 15 fresh-process samples per side, alternating origin/main and branch after bun install on each side; report median import CPU ms and RSS MiB for each side and delta. Account for eager subscription module/schema evaluation through dist/index.js, even if no subscription validator is called. Expected about +1.4 ms CPU and +0.1 MiB RSS for the move from 2.4.0 through eagerly loaded 2.5.0 subscription modules to the patch. A delta above 10 ms CPU or 2 MiB RSS is a finding in the PR.

Determine whether Docker with Compose is available for the full A/B. Without it, record the specific blocker and api nightly-main bench (.github/workflows/bench.yml) as gating check after merge; still complete local test CPU and startup import measurements.

With Docker Compose available, exit 0; API_MAIN_SHA and API_BRANCH_SHA are independently recorded main/branch commits. Record controlled refs, measured table, budgets and regression results per Performance impact and bench/README.md:76-100. Expect about +1-2 ms startup CPU, +0.1 MiB RSS, +0.1-0.3 s test CPU, no measurable load/p95/rps/cold/eod change. Without Docker, record blocker and nightly-main bench gate instead.
exit 0; all required repository CI checks pass.

Using isolated valid config/database and required tokens as AGENTS.md describes, start the API and manually exercise changed notify validation once through HTTP; record exact startup/HTTP commands, literal 422 or 201 result and error/original spelling in the PR, then stop. Do not use a shared database.

Includes both reader main pins and compare identical/ahead outputs before editing, api baseline ancestry, full independent main patch merge SHA/lockfile, three reject-case old-pin assertion failures, M4's old-pin 422 M1 (with error and no stored row), 204 control passing on both, and patch 422/204/201 plus both GET original-spelling results. Includes full checks/CI/manual startup+HTTP evidence; test CPU A/B five alternating samples per side, startup import A/B 15 per side with medians/deltas/findings and full Docker A/B or documented nightly-main gate. Includes applicable Security impact dependency-pin/input-validation review. Records readers-first activation: this only writer merges/releases after console and notify; first deploy image update ships patched api/console/notify together; rollback readers first unpads stored addresses and waits for notify sync; dev old-invalid rows require validation/remediation before console activation. No deploy or live data edits here.
